options.name: catalystcenter_debug
options.description: Flag for Cisco Catalyst Center SDK to enable debugging.

options.name: catalystcenter_password
options.description: The Cisco Catalyst Center password to authenticate.

options.name: catalystcenter_username
options.description: The Cisco Catalyst Center username to authenticate.

options.name: catalystcenter_verify
options.description: Flag to enable or disable SSL certificate verification.

options.name: catalystcenter_version
options.description: Informs the SDK which version of Cisco Catalyst Center to use.

options.name: endTime
options.description: EndTime query parameter. This is the epoch millisecond end time upto which task records need to be fetched.

options.name: id
options.description: Id path parameter. The `id` of the task to retrieve.

options.name: limit
options.description: Limit query parameter. The number of records to show for this page;The minimum is 1, and the maximum is 500.

options.name: offset
options.description: Offset query parameter. The first record to show for this page; the first record is numbered 1.

options.name: order
options.description: Order query parameter. Whether ascending or descending order should be used to sort the response.

options.name: parentId
options.description: ParentId query parameter. Fetch tasks that have this parent Id.

options.name: rootId
options.description: RootId query parameter. Fetch tasks that have this root Id.

options.name: sortBy
options.description: SortBy query parameter. A property within the response to sort by.

options.name: startTime
options.description: StartTime query parameter. This is the epoch millisecond start time from which tasks need to be fetched.

options.name: status
options.description: Status query parameter. Fetch tasks that have this status. Available values PENDING, FAILURE, SUCCESS.

options.name: validate_response_schema
options.description: Flag for Cisco Catalyst Center SDK to enable the validation of request bodies against a JSON schema.
